solutions.title: Path comparison
solutions.strategy: Build the BST search path to each target and return the last shared node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each target search follows one root-to-leaf path, where h is tree height.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The two explicit paths can store up to h nodes each.

solutions.title: Iterative BST walk
solutions.strategy: Walk downward until the two targets no longer belong strictly to the same side.

timeComplexity.explanation: The loop moves down one level per iteration.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the current pointer is stored.
